title: WAF Firewall
desc: Based on Coraza and the OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS), and can also use a self-hosted SafeLine detection engine. Reference an instance from a Web Service site to enable it
deleteConfirm: Delete this instance? Sites that reference it will no longer be inspected
paranoiaHelp: Higher is stricter with more false positives. Start from 1
bodyLimitHelp: 0 means the default 12.5 MB, up to 1024 MB
bodyLimitRejectHelp: Requests with a larger body get 413, so uploads of big files fail
bodyLimitPartialHelp: Only the part within the limit is inspected and the rest is passed to the backend unchanged; suited to sites that take big uploads, such as cloud drives and WebDAV
webdavHelp: Allows PUT, DELETE, PROPFIND, MKCOL, MOVE, COPY, LOCK and similar methods, the Lock-Token, If and Content-Range headers, and any upload content type; injection, path traversal and other attack checks still apply. For cloud drives, WebDAV and file managers
skipBodyPathsHelp: One path prefix per line, starting with /. Matching requests skip body inspection; headers, URL and query parameters are still inspected
customHelp: Rule groups load from top to bottom, and within the same phase earlier rules run first. Blocking rules work in any position; runtime allow rules (allow, ctl:ruleRemoveById, etc.) must be placed above the OWASP CRS group, or CRS may block the request first; configuration-time directives such as SecRuleRemoveById and SecRuleUpdateTargetById only affect rules already loaded, so place them below the CRS group
crsPlaceholder: Leave empty to enable all rule files
safelineHelp: Sends requests to your self-hosted Chaitin SafeLine detection engine, whose semantic analysis engine decides whether they are attacks. Blocks are counted in access logs, site statistics and Intrusion Guard, and attacks also appear in the SafeLine console
safelineAddrHelp: host:port, or a socket path starting with unix:. A default SafeLine installation does not listen on TCP: add bind_addr: 0.0.0.0 and listen_port: 8000 to detector.yml, restart safeline-detector and use that container's IP (e.g. 172.22.222.5:8000)
safelineBodyLimitHelp: 0 means the default 1024 KB; the rest is not inspected and is forwarded to the backend unchanged
safelineFailOpenHelp: Requests are allowed when the connection fails or times out, so a SafeLine outage does not take the site down
safelineFailClosedHelp: Requests get 503 when the connection fails or times out, leaving no gap in protection, but the site is unreachable while SafeLine is down
ruleSetsWithSafeline: With SafeLine connected, rule sets can be left empty; if you keep them, requests are checked by SafeLine first and then by the rule sets
safelineTestOk: Connected ({ms} ms), the sample attack was detected, event ID {id}
safelineTestNotBlocked: Connected ({ms} ms), but the sample attack was not detected; check the SafeLine protection settings
